senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. טוּר) [to go around; cmp. אָלַל,) to espy.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 47b:5">Shebu. 47ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ות̇ר̇ג̇נ̇ו</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 1:27">Deut. I, 27</cite>) <he>תַּ֗רְֹתֶּם וג̇ינ̇יתם באהלו וכ׳</he> you have espied (the land) and found fault with God’s tent; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:15">Num. R. s. 16<sup>20</sup></cite> <he>תרתם גנות א״י</he> you have espied the faults of the land of Israel; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 11.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:8">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>האתרים</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 21:1">Num. XXI, 1</cite>) <he>מת התייר הגדול שהיה תָר להם וכ׳</he> the great spy (Aaron) is dead who espied for them the road (of life); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:10:4">Y. Sot. I, end, 17ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19<sup>20</sup></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15">Lev. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 554:1">Yalk. ib. 554</cite> <he>את מבקש לצאת לָתוּר פרנסתך</he> thou desirest to go out and espy the means of thy sustenance; a. e.
